ebm.title: Climate Lab
ebm.description: Runs globally on this branch’s existing geological mesh. Trial settings and results stay in this map session and do not change the world.

browser.description: Run the full EBM in this browser. Your own world uses a grid built from its original heightmap; published worlds use the selected branch’s grid. The first run downloads the solver. Your data is never uploaded.
browser.cancelled: Trial cancelled. You can adjust the settings and run again.

ebm.ready: Trial complete. Computed {{cells}} cells in {{seconds}} s.
ebm.months: Moisture budget pass {{pass}}: {{done}} of {{total}} months solved.

ebm.name: EBM
ebm.help: The energy balance model runs Dreamulator’s fast climate solver and provides annual and monthly layers.

eps.name: EPS
eps.help: A WebGPU reimplementation of ExoPlaSim that simulates atmospheric circulation one time step at a time. (In development)

epsPlus.name: EPS++
epsPlus.help: An extension of EPS with coupled processes such as dynamic ocean currents. (In development)

progress.title: Run progress
progress.ready: Trial complete. Map layers are ready.

saved.title: Saved climate trial
saved.help: Save to World data on this server. The full world backup includes the trial. Official layers are not changed.
saved.confirmed: Saved to World data on this server.
saved.browserHelp: Keep this result in this browser’s World data. You can reopen or back it up without changing the published world.
saved.browserConfirmed: Saved to World data in this browser.
saved.openForRegion: Open saved trial and select a region
saved.loadFailed: Could not read the saved climate trial. The result may have been removed.
saved.saveFailed: Could not save the trial result. Try again, or rerun if the result has expired.
saved.surfaceMissing: This run has no elevation map to save. Check the source world's map and rerun the trial.
saved.restoredHelp: You are viewing a saved trial. Its layers and elevation come from this run and do not change when the official map is rebuilt.
saved.empty: This world has no saved climate trials yet.
saved.deleteFailed: Could not delete the climate trial.

fork.name: New branch name
fork.help: Use letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. The branch inherits the terrain and uses this climate for regional refinement.
fork.failed: Could not create the climate branch. Check the source map or rerun the trial.
fork.trial_source_changed: The source grid or build parameters changed. Rerun the trial with the current inputs.
fork.trial_branch_exists: That branch name is already in use. Choose another name.
fork.trial_primary_required: Climate branches currently support the world's primary planet only.
fork.trial_busy: A local build is running. Try again after it finishes.

error.browser_grid_limit: This grid exceeds the browser EBM’s size limit. Use a local server or switch to the temperature preview.
error.browser_unavailable: This map does not publish the inputs required for the full EBM. You can still use the temperature preview.
error.browser_incompatible: This browser lacks a feature required by the full EBM. Try an up-to-date browser or a local server.
error.browser_runtime: The browser solver could not start. Check your connection and try again.
error.browser_source: The EBM inputs could not be read. Check your connection and try again.
error.browser_run: The full EBM could not finish. Try again or switch to the temperature preview.
error.browser_products: The EBM map layers could not be loaded. Run the trial again.
error.browser_expired: This browser trial has ended or been cleared. Run it again to view the layers.
error.reference_anchor: The Earth main world is an observational reference. Switch to a model branch to run a trial.
error.build_inputs: Built astronomy data or body parameters are missing. Build the world first.
error.build_mesh: This body has no built geological mesh. Build the world first.
error.body_not_supported: This body has no geological parameters for the EBM. Select another body.
error.memory_budget: There is not enough memory for this mesh. Free memory or build the world with a smaller mesh.
error.trial_busy: A local climate trial is already running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
error.timed_out: The trial exceeded the local runtime limit. Try a smaller mesh.
error.params: Enter valid values for all four settings. The rotation period must be greater than zero.
error.generic: The local climate trial could not finish. Try again or check the technical details.

trial.title: World climate lab
trial.inlineSourceHelp: Uses global elevation from this branch, regardless of the map selection.
trial.draftSourceHelp: Uses the global elevation stored in this draft, even if the world's elevation has changed.
trial.draftRecovery: The source map is unavailable. You can still rerun the saved draft with its own elevation and settings here.
trial.selectedSamples: Samples taken at the centers of {{count}} selected world cells.
trial.cellSample: Sample at the center of world cell #{{id}}.
trial.defaults: Some settings are missing from the world data and use Earth defaults. Check the inputs before running.
trial.saveHelp: The draft saves settings and resampled elevation in this browser's World data, but does not save the results.
trial.saveError: Could not save this climate draft. Check available browser storage or remove an older draft.

action.loadingEngine: Loading and starting the browser runtime…

status.previousResult: Showing the previous result. Run again to apply the current settings.

view.placeholder: The first run may take longer while the browser loads the runtime. Once the result is ready, switch between annual and monthly maps without recalculating.

note: This preview uses a one-dimensional energy balance and a seasonal heat-capacity model. It does not calculate precipitation, winds, currents, or climate classes.
